studies.title: PB 与 ROE：估值和盈利能力的配对检验
studies.summary: 同一候选池的五种历史排序中，加入静态 ROE 后收益和信息比率低于仅用 PB 的对照；这不等于 ROE 普遍无效。
studies.source_note: 数值取自已公开并逐项核对的市场研究专题；原始财报版本和完整交易回放尚未独立复核。
rows: 质量调整 PB + ROE 变化
findings: 仅用 PB 的对照仍要求 ROE 可计算，不能当作完全不依赖 ROE 数据的纯 PB 组合。
放宽 ROE 非空要求后，合格股票月记录增加 46,803 条，约占扩大样本的 7.11%。
质量条件对结果有影响，但多项条件同时变化，不能归因于单个过滤器。
limits: 历史财报修订和公告可见时间尚未逐份独立核验。
整个历史区间参与过探索，不能重新标作严格样本外。
执行采用日线近似，缺少完整市场冲击和真实成交回放。

en-US.title: PB and ROE: A Paired Test of Valuation and Profitability
en-US.summary: Across five historical rankings on the same candidate pool, adding static ROE produced lower returns and information ratios than the PB-only comparison. This does not establish that ROE is generally ineffective.
en-US.source_note: Values come from a public market research study reviewed item by item; original filing versions and the complete trade replay have not been independently rechecked.
rows: Quality adjusted PB + change in ROE
findings: The PB-only comparison still requires ROE to be computable, so it should not be treated as a pure PB portfolio that is independent of ROE data.
Relaxing the non-null ROE requirement added 46,803 eligible stock-month records, about 7.11% of the expanded sample.
Quality conditions affect the result, but several conditions changed at the same time, so the effect cannot be attributed to a single filter.
limits: Historical filing revisions and announcement availability have not been independently checked record by record.
The full historical interval participated in exploration and cannot be relabeled as a strict out-of-sample period.
Execution uses a daily approximation and lacks a complete market impact and trade execution replay.

scope.en-US: Same eligible pool; five PB/ROE rankings
scope.zh-CN: 共同候选池；五种 PB/ROE 排序

baseline.en-US: PB ranking in the same quality-constrained pool
baseline.zh-CN: 同一质量约束候选池中的 PB 排序

input_basis.en-US: Historical filing-time reconstruction; original versions not independently rechecked
input_basis.zh-CN: 历史财报时点重建，原始版本未独立复核

rationale.en-US: Both examine whether a fundamental input adds beyond a valuation denominator.
rationale.zh-CN: 都检验基本面信息是否在估值分母之外增加信号。

rationale.en-US: Current profitability versus predicted profitability provides two ways to test the valuation bridge.
rationale.zh-CN: 当期盈利与预测盈利提供两种估值桥接检验。

rationale.en-US: Valuation and quality filters also help diagnose value traps in cash-flow portfolios.
rationale.zh-CN: 估值与质量过滤也可用于诊断现金流组合的价值陷阱。

rationale.en-US: Both require separating firm scale, current valuation and the proposed financial increment.
rationale.zh-CN: 都须分开公司规模、当期估值与拟检验财务增量。

resume_when.en-US: Recover versioned external inputs and rerun the same candidate-pool comparison before changing the PB baseline.
resume_when.zh-CN: 恢复有版本的外部输入并复跑相同候选池对照，再考虑改变 PB 基线。

action.en-US: Recover versioned external inputs and rerun the same candidate-pool comparison before changing the PB baseline.
action.zh-CN: 恢复有版本的外部输入并复跑相同候选池对照，再考虑改变 PB 基线。

acceptance.en-US: Retain an immutable audit with the named evidence gap resolved; preserve the previous decision if the gate fails.
acceptance.zh-CN: 保留不可变审计并解决上述证据缺口；门槛未通过则保留原判断。

studies.title: 研发投入和公司规模，谁更能解释股票表现？
studies.summary: Historical execution diagnostics still have unresolved prices and formation gaps; R&D remains a research candidate. The corrected sealed announcement-event PIT run reports 4.85% / 12.81% Rank IC for 20 / 220 trading-day labels across 77 / 66 horizon-specific monthly cross-sections. The result is exploratory and does not establish executable returns; the full revision chain remains incomplete.
studies.period: Corrected PIT replay: 2020-01 through 2026-06; 77 valid 20-day and 66 valid 220-day cross-sections
studies.source_note: 来源：修正后的公告事件 PIT 回放，vintage=20260926。当前来源报告分期限 Rank IC 和独立的 Top-200 成本探针；历史财报修订链和冻结最终 OOS 就绪门槛仍未解决。更早的 2019 年扩展年度快照作为独立遗留产物保留，不属于此处当前汇总。
rows: Five-year decayed R&D stock / market cap
findings: A separate historical follow-up identifies 10,825 unique endpoint failure events across 3,894 securities. None of 70 factor/decile sequences passes every endpoint; this is not formal portfolio validation.
The corrected PIT sample contains 77 valid 20-day and 66 valid 220-day monthly cross-sections; median cross-sectional sizes are about 4,454 and 4,230 stocks.
R&D / market cap and five-year decayed R&D stock show positive exploratory Rank IC. The 220-day labels overlap and are not independent observations.
The full style residual is weaker than raw R&D / market cap. This does not establish an independent, causal, or tradable R&D premium.
R&D / revenue, R&D / assets, and R&D growth do not show stable ranking evidence in the corrected sample.

A separate fixed Top-200 platform probe at 25 bp one-way modeled cost reports 12.70% annualized return, 0.57 Sharpe, and -25.75% max drawdown over 89 holding periods. It is a research diagnostic, not a registered decile validation or production portfolio.
The 2026-10 to 2027-09 prospective final-OOS protocol is frozen but blocked from performance reading; no frozen holdout metrics have been produced.
limits: The historical financial statement revision chain is incomplete. The corrected historical reconstruction is not revision-safe, and historical index/industry effective times are not fully point-in-time verified.
The 220-day labels overlap. Cross-sectional Rank IC and the Top-200 price-return probe do not establish executable fills, market impact, or a deployable portfolio.
The Top-200 cost probe is separate from registered decile validation; the full frozen-holdout readiness audit still blocks performance reading.
The older 2019 extended annual snapshot uses a separate retrospective reconstruction and is not included in the corrected current-run metrics above.
2026-10-02 输入审计补齐了原始与调整后报表，并实现受实际采集时间约束的版本留存。这些后来采集的数据不能证明严格历史 PIT。R&D 冻结窗口持续至 2027 年 9 月，需等全部长期标签成熟后才能解封，约在 2028 年。本次未读取冻结表现。

en-US.title: Are stock returns linked to R&D, or to company size?
en-US.summary: The main question is whether companies that spend more on R&D, relative to their size, tend to have better later stock returns. The corrected screen finds a positive average ranking relationship: Rank IC is 4.85% for the next 20 trading days and 12.81% for the next 220. These percentages are correlations between rankings, not stock returns. The longer-window comparisons overlap, historical financial records are incomplete, and the study has not shown that the pattern can be traded.
en-US.period: Corrected announcement-date-aligned study: 2020-01 to 2026-06; 77 monthly comparisons for the 20-day outcome and 66 for the 220-day outcome
en-US.source_note: Source: corrected announcement-date-aligned replay, vintage=20260926. The source reports separate results for each outcome window and a separate Top-200 trading simulation. Historical statement revisions and readiness to read the sealed future holdout remain unresolved. The older annual reconstruction extending to 2019 is a separate archive and is not included in these current results.
rows: Five-year decayed R&D stock / market cap
findings: A separate history check flagged 10,825 planned holding-price checks across 3,894 securities. None of 70 factor-by-decile result series had complete prices at every checked point. These flags are not confirmed failed orders and do not count as a completed portfolio test.
The corrected screen has 77 usable monthly comparisons for the 20-day outcome and 66 for the 220-day outcome. The median number of eligible stocks per month is about 4,454 and 4,230, respectively.

R&D / market cap and the five-year decayed R&D measure have positive average Rank IC in this exploratory sample. The 220-day outcome windows overlap, so neighboring monthly comparisons share return days.

After removing the measured links to size, valuation, leverage, momentum and industry, the remaining R&D / market-cap relationship is weaker. This does not show that R&D independently causes higher returns or can be traded profitably.
R&D / revenue, R&D / assets and R&D growth do not show a stable positive ranking relationship in the corrected sample.

A separate fixed Top-200 trading simulation reports 12.70% annualized return, Sharpe 0.57 and maximum drawdown −25.75% across 89 holding periods, with a modeled one-way cost of 25 basis points. It is not the registered ten-group validation or a production portfolio.
The future test window, October 2026 through September 2027, is fixed but remains sealed. Its results have not been read or published.
limits: The saved history does not contain every version of each financial report as investors originally saw it. Announcement dates are aligned, but the reconstruction is not yet verified as fully point-in-time accurate; historical index membership and industry dates also need review.

The 220-day outcome windows overlap. Rank IC describes how two rankings move together; it is not a return. The separate Top-200 simulation does not prove that orders could be filled at the assumed prices or that real market impact was captured.
The Top-200 simulation is separate from the registered ten-group validation. The readiness review for the sealed future test (the frozen-holdout) still does not permit reading its performance.
The older annual archive extending back to 2019 was rebuilt separately. Its results are not part of the corrected current results above.

The 2026-10-02 input review added original and adjusted reports and began keeping versions from their actual collection dates. Because this collection began later, it cannot recreate strict historical point-in-time records. The future R&D test window runs through September 2027; all long-window results need time to mature, so the earliest expected review is around 2028. No future-test performance has been read.
The newer quality and matched-component checks use the older rebuilt history. Their sample counts and results are kept separate from the corrected current study.

zh-CN.title: 研发投入和公司规模，谁更能解释股票表现？
zh-CN.summary: 这项研究想知道：相对于公司规模，研发投入更多的公司，之后的股票收益是否也更好？修正后的筛查发现，研发指标排序与后续收益排序平均呈正相关：未来 20 个交易日的 Rank IC 为 4.85%，未来 220 日为 12.81%。百分数表示两个排序的相关程度，不是股票收益率。较长期窗口彼此重叠，历史财报版本也不完整，目前尚未证明这种关系能实际交易。
zh-CN.period: 修正后的公告日期对齐研究：2020-01 至 2026-06；20 日结果有 77 个月度比较，220 日结果有 66 个
zh-CN.source_note: 来源：修正后的公告日期对齐回放，vintage=20260926。来源分别报告了不同收益窗口的排序相关，并另做了一项 Top-200 交易模拟。历史财报修订版本和读取封存前瞻留出结果的资格仍未解决。延伸至 2019 年的早期年度重建是独立档案，不属于本页当前结果。
rows: 五年衰减研发资本 / 市值
findings: 另一次历史价格核查，在 3,894 只证券上标记了 10,825 个计划持仓价格检查点。70 条“因子 × 十分组”收益序列都至少有一个检查点缺少完整价格。这些标记不等于已确认的订单失败，也不算完成了组合验证。
修正后的筛查中，未来 20 日结果有 77 个可用的月度比较，220 日结果有 66 个。每个月符合条件的股票数中位数分别约为 4,454 和 4,230 只。
在这组探索性样本中，“研发 / 市值”和“五年衰减研发资本”对应的平均 Rank IC 为正。220 日观察窗口彼此重叠，相邻月份会共享部分未来收益日。
从“研发 / 市值”排序中扣除与规模、估值、杠杆、动量和行业相关的部分后，剩下的关系较弱。这不能证明研发本身造成了更高收益，也不能证明它能赚钱交易。
修正样本中的“研发 / 收入”“研发 / 资产”和“研发增长”没有显示稳定的正向排序关系。
另一个固定 Top-200 交易模拟报告了 89 个持有区间：年化收益 12.70%、Sharpe 0.57、最大回撤 −25.75%，并假设单边模型成本为 25 个基点。这不是预先登记的十分组验证，也不是正式运行的组合。
未来检验期定为 2026 年 10 月至 2027 年 9 月，目前仍封存；结果尚未读取或发布。
limits: 留存的历史资料没有包含投资者当时看到的每一版财报。研究已按公告日期对齐，但还不能确认所有历史数据都严格符合点时要求；历史指数成分和行业日期也仍需核查。
220 日观察窗口彼此重叠。Rank IC 只说明两种排序是否一起变化，不是收益。Top-200 模拟也不能证明订单能按假设价格成交，或已完整计入真实市场冲击。
Top-200 模拟与预先登记的十分组验证是两项不同检查。封存的未来检验尚未通过读取绩效的准备门槛。
延伸至 2019 年的早期年度档案来自单独的历史重建，不包含在上方修正后的当前结果中。
2026-10-02 的输入核查补充了原始和调整后财报，并开始按实际采集日期留存版本。由于采集开始较晚，这无法还原严格的历史点时记录。研发未来检验期到 2027 年 9 月结束；长期结果还要等标签成熟，预计最早约在 2028 年复核。本次没有读取前瞻检验表现。
较新的质量和相同样本对照使用的是早期重建数据。它们的样本数量和结果与修正后的当前研究分开呈现。

research_log.note: 从研发 / 市值线索出发，明确区分研发投入信息与市值分母带来的规模、估值暴露。
research_log.note_en: Started from the R&D/market-cap observation and separated the R&D signal question from size and valuation effects embedded in the denominator.

research_log.stage: 预先确定七种研发算法，并按财报公开日期检查
research_log.stage_en: Set seven R&D measures in advance and aligned them to report dates
research_log.note: 先固定七种研发算法和 20／220 个后续交易日的收益观察期，再按财报公告日期确定每项信息从何时可用。每个月末比较一次，只展示汇总结果。
research_log.note_en: The seven R&D measures and 20/220-trading-day outcome windows were fixed first. Each input was then aligned to when its financial report became public. The study compares stocks at each month-end and displays aggregate results.

research_log.stage: 补记一段历史观察，不当作前瞻检验
research_log.stage_en: Recorded a past-period check, not a prospective test
research_log.note: 补记 2026-04 至 2026-07 四个月中，按信号选出的最高十分之一股票的未扣成本收益；七种算法均为负。记录时间晚于同日预注册日志，现有材料不能证明这段数据事先封存，因此不称为前瞻或最终样本外检验。
research_log.note_en: A later note records the before-cost returns for the highest-ranked tenth of stocks from April through July 2026; all seven measures were negative. The note was written after the preregistration entry on the same day, and the available record cannot show that this period was sealed in advance. It is therefore not treated as a prospective or final out-of-sample test.

research_log.stage: 修正研发指标定义并重新计算
research_log.stage_en: Corrected the R&D measures and recalculated the results
research_log.note: 修正按公告日期对齐的研发指标后，重新计算月度排序相关值和分组结果。旧版 Top-200 交易模拟、成本压力检查、CPCV 历史分割检验和未来留出没有随这次重算，因此结果仍属初步研究。
research_log.note_en: After correcting the announcement-date-aligned R&D measures, the monthly rank correlations and group results were recalculated. The older Top-200 simulation, cost checks, CPCV historical split checks, and future holdout were not rerun as part of this calculation, so the study remains preliminary.

research_log.stage: 将历史行情回补至 2015 并检查 PIT 覆盖
research_log.stage_en: Extended the historical replay to 2015 and audited PIT coverage
research_log.note: 把历史行情延伸到 2015 年后，重新计算各月的排序相关值和分组结果。当时旧版 Top-200 模拟、成本检查、CPCV 历史分割检验和未来留出还未更新；后续检查记录在 2026-10-01。
research_log.note_en: After extending the historical prices back to 2015, the monthly rank correlations and group results were recalculated. The older Top-200 simulation, cost checks, CPCV split checks, and future holdout had not yet been updated; the later work is recorded on 2026-10-01.

research_log.stage: 检查交易成本、统计不确定性和市值分母影响
research_log.stage_en: Checked trading costs, statistical uncertainty, and the market-value denominator
research_log.note: 同一份修正后样本另做了固定 Top-200 的成本对照，用 Newey–West／HAC 调整相邻月份可能相关带来的不确定性，并用 BH 方法校正同时比较多种结果的影响；也拆开检查研发费用和市值分母各自的关系。单独看时，较小市值的对应关系强于研发费用金额；结论仍属探索。另将 2026-10 至 2027-09 的未来检验期封存，等 220 日观察期结束后再评估。
research_log.note_en: The corrected sample was also used for a fixed Top-200 cost comparison. Newey–West/HAC adjusts uncertainty when neighboring months may be related; the BH method adjusts when many results are checked together. The analysis also separates the R&D amount from its market-value denominator. On its own, smaller company size has a stronger association than R&D expense. This remains exploratory. A future test period from October 2026 through September 2027 was also sealed until the 220-day outcomes mature.

research_log.note: 补查年度持仓价格是否齐全、行业和其他比较字段是否存在，并在同一批公司上对照研发金额与市值影响；还人工核对了 10 份财报。找到的全天停牌记录帮助解释部分价格缺口，但仍没有完整的组合持有价格。较早历史扩展与当前修正结果分开，未来留出继续封存。
research_log.note_en: The review checked whether annual holding prices were present, whether industry and other comparison fields were available, and how R&D amount compared with company size on the same stocks. It also manually checked ten financial reports. Explicit full-day suspension records explain some missing prices, but the study still lacks complete prices throughout a portfolio holding period. The older historical extension remains separate, and the future holdout stays sealed.

scope.en-US: R&D numerator versus valuation and style exposure
scope.zh-CN: 研发分子与估值、风格暴露

baseline.en-US: R&D/market cap; scale and alternative denominators
baseline.zh-CN: 研发/市值；规模与替代分母对照

input_basis.en-US: Announcement-event reconstruction; complete correction chain absent
input_basis.zh-CN: 公告事件重建，完整更正链缺失

sample.zh-CN: 20 / 220 日分别为 77 / 66 个月度截面

rationale.en-US: Both examine whether a fundamental input adds beyond a valuation denominator.
rationale.zh-CN: 都检验基本面信息是否在估值分母之外增加信号。

rationale.en-US: Labor and R&D inputs both require stock/flow and capitalization distinctions.
rationale.zh-CN: 劳动与研发投入都须区分存量、流量及资本化。

resume_when.en-US: Before using this as a portfolio, fill missing stock prices and exit values and verify which stocks qualified on each past date. Keep the future test sealed until its checks are ready.
resume_when.zh-CN: 用于组合之前，先补齐缺失股价和退出结算，并核实每个历史日期符合条件的股票。未来检验期在检查条件满足前继续封存。

action.en-US: Before using this as a portfolio, fill missing stock prices and exit values and verify which stocks qualified on each past date. Keep the future test sealed until its checks are ready.
action.zh-CN: 用于组合之前，先补齐缺失股价和退出结算，并核实每个历史日期符合条件的股票。未来检验期在检查条件满足前继续封存。

acceptance.en-US: 保留带日期且不可覆盖的审计记录，逐项证明缺失价格、退出结算和股票资格问题已解决；只要仍有缺口，研究结论就维持探索阶段。
acceptance.zh-CN: 保留带日期且不可覆盖的审计记录，逐项证明缺失价格、退出结算和股票资格问题已解决；只要仍有缺口，研究结论就维持探索阶段。

action.en-US: Paired uncertainty, annual / size slices and calibration retained under the fixed retrospective follow-up.
action.zh-CN: 已按固定回溯方案保留配对不确定性、年度／规模切片与校准记录。

acceptance.en-US: Hashes and original cohort/metric reproduction checks passed; no executable return claim.
acceptance.zh-CN: 哈希与原始样本／指标复现检查通过，不声称可执行收益。

zh-CN.title: 基本面状态预测：从财务预测到截面选股
zh-CN.family: 基本面预测与经营质量
zh-CN.summary: 研究预测未来 ROA、毛利率、营收增速、净利润增速及现金转化，再检验预测能否改善截面排序和组合。盈利状态有较强持续性，但复杂模型没有稳定超过 persistence；一次净利润增速的正向比较没有在后续同折复核中稳定复现。
zh-CN.source_note: 来源：基本面状态预测与长期基本面 v2 研究记录。预测准确度不等同于股票收益证据。
findings: ROA 和毛利率水平具有较强持续性，XGBoost 未稳定超过 persistence。
营收增速预测能力随期限衰减；净利润增速结果依样本面板变化。
预测转组合的历史桥接表现不稳定，尚未建立稳定投资增量。
limits: 公告时点重建不等于供应商完整修订历史；长周期标签重叠且组合样本偏短。
当前来源没有单独验证未来营收或净利润绝对值预测作为截面选股因子的研究；该方向仍需找到原始实验记录。
结果属于回溯诊断，不是成熟前瞻样本外或生产审批。

en-US.title: Fundamental-state forecasting: from financial predictions to cross-sectional selection
en-US.summary: The study forecasts future ROA, gross margin, revenue growth, net-profit growth, and cash conversion, then tests whether forecasts improve cross-sectional ranking and portfolios. Profitability states are persistent, but complex models did not consistently beat persistence. A positive net-profit-growth comparison did not remain stable in the later common-fold review.
en-US.period: September 2–4, 2026; annual and one-to-four-quarter forecast targets
en-US.source_note: Source: the fundamental-state forecasting and long-term fundamental v2 research records. Forecast accuracy is not treated as stock-return evidence.
findings: ROA and gross-margin levels are persistent; XGBoost did not consistently beat persistence.
Revenue-growth prediction weakens with horizon; net-profit-growth results vary by panel.
Historical forecast-to-portfolio bridges are unstable and do not establish a durable investment increment.
limits: Announcement-time reconstruction is not a complete vendor revision history; long-horizon labels overlap and portfolio samples are short.
The current source set does not document a separately validated factor that selects stocks using predicted absolute revenue or net-profit levels; that direction needs its original experiment note.
These are retrospective diagnostics, not mature prospective evidence or production approval.

findings: The common-baseline design helps separate individual family contributions from the combined score.
This page is a research map and ablation protocol, not evidence that a V/Q/G portfolio is effective.
limits: Historical runs participated in research selection and are not prospective OOS.

en-US.title: Cash Flow Indices: Rule Reproduction and Strategy Boundaries
en-US.summary: Cash flow, dividend, and related self-built portfolios have partial rule reproduction and aggregate replay evidence, but this is not yet a complete reproduction of official constituents or a production strategy validation.
en-US.period: Period covered by available constituent snapshots; the complete ten-year official constituent replay is not complete
en-US.source_note: Data comes from the public research entry in the quantitative research repository. The official index, the rule-reconstructed shadow index, and the self-built portfolio are separate evidence types.
findings: Daily return correlations on available constituent snapshots support rule research and local calibration, but do not establish a complete reproduction of official constituents.
980092, 932365, and 000922 must be distinguished as the current research object, a broad benchmark, and a dividend benchmark.
Further work must check historical rule changes, point-in-time filing coverage, size/industry/valuation/quality attribution, and a unified transaction cost assumption.
limits: Available constituent snapshots do not cover the complete ten-year history of official constituents and rule changes.
The public projection keeps aggregate results only and does not represent per-security signals, portfolio weights, or executable replay.
This has not entered a production strategy or produced a complete out-of-sample conclusion.

en-US.title: Hong Kong PIT fundamentals: archived monthly and quarterly studies
en-US.family: Hong Kong fundamental forecasts, ranking, and portfolio diagnostics
en-US.summary: The archive covers pure-fundamental baselines, target transforms, variants without return features, valuation and cash-flow overlays, benchmark attribution, universe checks, and regime diagnostics. All three quarterly pure-fundamental model arms had negative full-test returns, with no positive return across six walk-forward windows. A brighter recent final-OOS segment does not override that record.
en-US.period: Versioned notes: March 24–April 20, 2026; monthly and quarterly
en-US.source_note: Source: the Hong Kong experiment recovery index and its 26 classified notes. Frozen run assets remain outside this repository.
findings: Monthly and quarterly notes examine fundamental targets, PIT features, market regimes, and portfolio construction.
The quarterly pure-fundamental full-test and walk-forward results were weak; recent-window results are historical regime observations.
Monthly no-return variants improved selected IC windows but remain archived candidates.
limits: The frozen assets can be integrity-checked, but the repository alone does not provide end-to-end reproduction of every data and run.
Hong Kong findings describe historical Hong Kong research and do not establish transferability to A-shares.

en-US.title: Absolute revenue and net-income forecasts: a selection pilot
en-US.summary: An audited annual PIT sample of 32,339 common rows forecasts next-year revenue and consolidated net-income levels, then compares top-decile screens. Persistence has lower transformed MAE than Ridge and XGBoost in all six comparisons; XGBoost net-income RankIC gains are tiny and selection results vary across years.
en-US.period: Formation cohorts 2020–2025; forecast and one-year return folds 2023–2025
en-US.source_note: Annual event-PIT panel vintage 20260802, outcomes as of 20260831. Net income is consolidated n_income including minority interests, not parent-attributable income. Market-cap inputs use data on or before formation. Provider revisions, outcome coverage, and delisting eligibility are incomplete; this is retrospective, not strict final OOS.
findings: Persistence has lower transformed MAE than both learned models in all six target-year comparisons.
XGBoost net-income RankIC is only 0.002–0.005 above persistence; this small ranking increment does not establish stock-return alpha.
The three annual selection windows disagree; Ridge forecast-yield excess reverses in 2025 and XGBoost forecast-yield excess is positive only in 2023.
limits: Only three annual forecast/return folds are available; provider revision history, outcome-panel coverage, and all-market delisting eligibility are incomplete.
Price returns use adjusted-close proxies, a price-complete survivor subset, no dividends or delisting recovery, and fixed 25 bp one-way modeled costs.
Selection screens are not industry-, size-, liquidity-, or benchmark-risk controlled and are not a mature portfolio replay.

The 2026-10-02 input audit supplemented original and adjusted statements and implemented retrieval-time-bounded version retention. These later observations cannot certify strict historical PIT. The frozen R&D window runs through September 2027 and all long-horizon labels must mature before performance is unsealed, approximately in 2028. No frozen performance was read.

zh-CN.title: 营收与净利润绝对值预测：截面选股试验
zh-CN.family: 基本面预测与截面选股
zh-CN.summary: 在 32,339 个共同样本的年度 PIT 试验中预测下一年营收和合并净利润绝对值，再比较 Top Decile 选股。Persistence 在六个目标年比较中的变换 MAE 均优于 Ridge 与 XGBoost；XGBoost 净利润 RankIC 增量很小，年度选股结果差异明显。

zh-CN.source_note: 年度公告事件 PIT 面板 vintage=20260802，结果快照 as_of=20260831。净利润为包含少数股东损益的合并 n_income，不是归母净利润。市值取形成日及之前数据。供应商修订、结果覆盖和退市资格审计不完整；这是回溯研究，不是严格最终 OOS。

findings: 六个目标年比较中，persistence 的变换 MAE 均低于两种学习模型。
XGBoost 净利润 RankIC 只比 persistence 高 0.002–0.005；如此微弱的排序增量不能证明股票收益 Alpha。
三个年度选股窗口结论不一致；Ridge 预测收益率超额于 2025 年反转，XGBoost 预测收益率超额只有 2023 年为正。

rationale.zh-CN: 绝对值目标试验扩展目标选择，继续保留持续性对照。

rationale.en-US: Both require separating firm scale, current valuation and the proposed financial increment.
rationale.zh-CN: 都须分开公司规模、当期估值与拟检验财务增量。

resume_when.en-US: Add qualified historical revisions, industry and market-cap controls, longer cohorts and delisting-aware returns before promotion.
resume_when.zh-CN: 先补充可靠历史版本、行业与市值控制、更长样本和退市感知收益，再考虑升级。

action.en-US: Add qualified historical revisions, industry and market-cap controls, longer cohorts and delisting-aware returns before promotion.
action.zh-CN: 先补充可靠历史版本、行业与市值控制、更长样本和退市感知收益，再考虑升级。

acceptance.en-US: Retain an immutable audit with the named evidence gap resolved; preserve the previous decision if the gate fails.
acceptance.zh-CN: 保留不可变审计并解决上述证据缺口；门槛未通过则保留原判断。

action.en-US: Paired uncertainty, annual / size slices and calibration retained under the fixed retrospective follow-up.
action.zh-CN: 已按固定回溯方案保留配对不确定性、年度／规模切片与校准记录。

acceptance.en-US: Hashes and original cohort/metric reproduction checks passed; no executable return claim.
acceptance.zh-CN: 哈希与原始样本／指标复现检查通过，不声称可执行收益。

en-US.title: Fundamental research across factors and markets
en-US.summary: A source-linked map of R&D investment, value and quality, cash flow, operating-state forecasts, historical Hong Kong experiments, and a pilot of absolute financial-level forecasts.
en-US.scope: The public factor catalog lists 23 fundamental and human-capital candidates. Catalog inclusion describes a research question; it does not mean the factor has passed validation.
en-US.evidence_boundary: Forecast accuracy, cross-sectional ranking, and executable portfolio returns are separate evidence stages. Historical Hong Kong findings remain market-specific and do not establish A-share transferability.

zh-CN.title: 跨因子与市场的基本面研究
zh-CN.summary: 按来源串联研发投入、价值与质量、现金流、经营状态预测、港股历史实验，以及一项财务绝对值预测试验。
zh-CN.scope: 公开因子目录列出 23 个基本面与人力资本候选。进入目录表示有研究问题，不代表因子已通过验证。
zh-CN.evidence_boundary: 预测准确度、截面排序能力和可执行组合收益属于不同证据阶段。港股历史发现只适用于对应市场，不能据此认定可迁移到 A 股。

scope.zh-CN: 同一历史候选池、日期窗口与年化超额指标。

scope.zh-CN: 同一标准影子协议与所选持仓宽度；官方历史保持独立。

trigger.zh-CN: 共同池排序排除入选差异。

after.en-US: Static ROE did not improve the PB comparator in this history.
after.zh-CN: 静态 ROE 在本历史对照中没有改善 PB。

before.en-US: Raw R&D/market-cap correlation could be read as an R&D premium.
before.zh-CN: 原始研发/市值相关性可能被解释为研发溢价。

trigger.en-US: Style controls and alternate scales weaken the signal.
trigger.zh-CN: 风格控制与替代尺度使信号减弱。

after.en-US: Retain an exploratory valuation-linked signal; independence is unresolved.
after.zh-CN: 保留探索性估值相关信号，独立性未解决。

before.en-US: A frozen protocol could appear ready to evaluate immediately.
before.zh-CN: 冻结协议可能看起来可以立即评估。

trigger.en-US: The prospective window and long labels have not matured.
trigger.zh-CN: 前瞻窗口与长期标签尚未成熟。

after.en-US: The holdout remains sealed; no performance reading is authorized by this display.
after.zh-CN: 留出仍封存；本次呈现不赋予读取表现的资格。

before.en-US: An initial persistence result had an impossible Rank IC of 1.
before.zh-CN: 最初 persistence 结果出现不合理的 Rank IC=1。

trigger.en-US: The baseline incorrectly read future values; the run was corrected.
trigger.zh-CN: 基线错误读取未来值，运行随后修正。

after.en-US: Exclude the invalid run and use corrected current-state baselines only.
after.zh-CN: 排除无效运行，仅使用修正的当期状态基线。

before.en-US: One annual panel showed a positive net-profit-growth model increment.
before.zh-CN: 一个年度面板显示正向净利润增速模型增量。

trigger.en-US: Later common-fold objectives did not show a stable learned-model advantage.
trigger.zh-CN: 后续共同折目标对照没有显示稳定学习模型优势。

after.en-US: The early observation remains recorded without model or portfolio promotion.
after.zh-CN: 保留早期观察，不提升模型或组合资格。

before.en-US: Combining useful-looking families might seem sufficient.
before.zh-CN: 组合看似有用的家族可能显得已经足够。

trigger.en-US: A protocol and common keys exist, but reviewed family performance does not.
trigger.zh-CN: 已有协议与共同键，但尚无已复核家族绩效。

after.en-US: Keep family effectiveness unproven until the ablation is reviewed.
after.zh-CN: 消融复核之前，家族有效性仍未证明。

before.en-US: High official-return correlation might be read as complete index replication.
before.zh-CN: 较高官方收益相关性可能被理解为完整指数复现。

trigger.en-US: Available snapshots leave missing historical constituents and rule changes.
trigger.zh-CN: 可用快照仍缺历史成分，并存在规则变化。

after.en-US: Treat calibration and current-rule shadows as separate, bounded evidence.
after.zh-CN: 将校准与现行规则影子视为独立且有边界的证据。

before.zh-CN: 近期最终窗口亮点较好。

trigger.en-US: Full quarterly tests and all six walk-forward windows were weak.
trigger.zh-CN: 完整季频测试及六个前推窗口均弱。

after.en-US: Recent performance is a regime observation and does not replace the full record.
after.zh-CN: 近期表现是阶段观察，不能替换完整记录。

before.zh-CN: 仅金融组主动收益看似最强。

trigger.en-US: The same monthly diagnostic reports negative financial-only IC.
trigger.zh-CN: 同一月频诊断记录仅金融组 IC 为负。

after.en-US: Retain sector and concentration attribution; do not infer a superior ranking signal.
after.zh-CN: 保留行业与集中度归因，不推断更优排序信号。

before.en-US: Employee compensation payable might proxy current wages.
before.zh-CN: 应付职工薪酬可能被当作当期工资代理。

trigger.en-US: The field is a period-end liability balance.
trigger.zh-CN: 该字段为期末负债余额。

after.en-US: Require expense flows and workforce coverage before a predictive test.
after.zh-CN: 预测检验前须取得费用流量与员工人数覆盖。

before.en-US: Complex models might improve forecasts of financial levels.
before.zh-CN: 复杂模型可能改善财务水平预测。

trigger.en-US: Persistence wins all six transformed-MAE comparisons.
trigger.zh-CN: 持续性赢得全部六项变换 MAE 对照。

after.en-US: No learned-model promotion follows; test the selection bridge independently.
after.zh-CN: 不提升学习模型资格，独立检验选股桥接。
